title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup Hit by Supply-Chain Attack
excerpt: Hackers breached Microsoft 365 tenants after compromising application identities in a ConnectWise supply-chain attack.
body_html:
ConnectWise has temporarily disabled customer access to its Cloud Backup service, previously known as SkyKick Cloud Backup, following a security incident.

According to the company, attackers managed to access application identities linked to the backup tool. This unauthorized access was then used to compromise multiple Microsoft 365 tenants.

Investigation and remediation efforts are currently underway regarding the supply-chain attack. Further updates are expected as more information becomes available.
